method: Actual production Chromium viewport recordings and unretouched PNGs. About is a cold direct visit; phase samples follow the real startup clock without timeline seeks or altered attributes/styles. The actual observed entrance/scene/state/reason and image/animation state accompany every scheduled sample, including any parent static fallback. Native wheel input and an ordinary service link reach the preserved Services hero, Brand Identity puzzle and reversible raster footer. Mobile is Chromium touch/viewport emulation, not a physical-device benchmark.
